F15: Immunohistochemical staining: tumor cells negative for S-100 protein, pancytokeratin, epithelial membrane antigen, and CD31
F10: Light microscopy findings: dermal tumor extended into the superficial subcutis, composed of nests and fascicles of spindle-shaped to epithelioid cells
F11: Cell characteristics: pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, vesicular nuclei, and prominent nucleoli within a collagenous stroma
F12: Mitotic figures, including atypical forms: 7–8 per 10 high-power fields
